metadata.description: Thai VTuber Dynamic Temporal Network (Observed Commenters & Live Chat Participants with Dated Interaction Evidence)
metadata.sampling_strategy: deterministic SHA-256 hash ranking; first-ranked candidate per temporal bin
metadata.note: Historical audience network based on stratified samples of dated commenter/chat interaction evidence. It does not represent all YouTube viewers or exhaustive comment history. Undated observations are excluded from temporal slices. Video publication date is never substituted for audience interaction time.
